The Plates

Four plates. Yours is struck at mint.

Free is steel. Paid is gold — and a Paid draw can strike Rare in silver and gold, or Legendary in full gold. The Rare and Legendary plates are struck blank: your number, your wallet and your name are engraved the moment you mint.

FAQ

Four answers.

What is AgentCard?+

A collection of 2,222 Agent ID Card NFTs on BNB Chain — engraved metal emblems issued as ID cards, each inscribed with its owner, number, tier and mint date.

What is the difference between Free and Paid?+

Free: 0 BNB, Agent ID holders, max 2, steel Standard Common — no roll. Paid: 0.0012 BNB, all wallets, max 5, gold Premium — the only rarity roll (Common 50% · Rare 32% · Legendary 18%). Same 3 steps either way.

Do I have to wait for Free Mint to end before I can Paid Mint?+

No. There are no phases. Free and Paid are separate pools — 1,888 and 334 — and both open at the same moment. Paid Mint never waits for Free, and it never needs a Binance Agent ID.

How does the inscription work?+

Automatically at step 3. Number (F- within 1,888, P- within 334), your wallet as owner, tier, issue and mint date — engraved in gold on Paid, stamped in steel on Free.

Can I trade my card, and when does mint open?+

Yes — every AgentCard is a standard ERC-721 you can list, sell and trade on any BNB Chain marketplace. The contract is live on BNB Chain (0x3091…2a92) and minting here is real and on-chain. To mint: 1 — Connect wallet, 2 — Pick Free or Paid, 3 — Mint — or use the two prompts in Agent Mint.
